issue.body:
Canonical successor for [danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5845](https://github.com/danielbaustin/agent-design-language/issues/5845).

## Migration semantics

- `replaces`: danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5845 as active current-repository issue authority.
- The archived source body is preserved below without claiming implementation, review, publication, merge, or terminal progress.
- Continue all future planning and lifecycle work only on this current-repository successor.

## Archived source issue body

## Summary

Execute **WP-24A** for v0.92 within this issue's approved design and ownership boundary.

Create and validate ten review-ready production packages using retained Podcast Studio v2 proof and the approved route/storage decision. Complete episode checkpoints may land incrementally, but a checkpoint must include the full package contract for every episode it labels complete. Do not close WP-24A until all ten packages and the integration proof are complete.

## Required Outcome

All first ten episodes are complete review-ready production packages, not topic or schema placeholders.

## Episode Package Contract

Each complete episode includes canonical episode metadata, source packet, script, transcript, show notes, final MP3 and archive audio with manifests, QA report, guest metadata, artwork and ID3 metadata, RSS enclosure record, redaction report, and editorial/audio review.

Shared audio routes are allowed when the episode metadata, audio manifest, and enclosure record bind the exact paths, byte counts, and SHA-256 digests.

An incremental checkpoint:

- includes the complete package for each episode it claims;
- passes the applicable positive and negative validators;
- uses `Part of danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5845`, not a closing keyword;
- leaves this parent issue open.

## Deliverables

- Ten complete episode directories
- Ten final MP3 and archive-audio artifacts with manifests
- Validated feed and enclosure records
- Audio, redaction, guest, metadata, playback, and listen-check QA
- Exact-head editorial/audio review

## Dependencies

- #5819 canonical naming/link truth
- #3223 and #3256 retained Podcast Studio v2 proof
- Agent Logic route/storage decision

## Owned Paths

- `docs/milestones/v0.91.8/review/podcast_launch_5711/episodes.json`

## Validation And Proof

- Prove complete package contents, audio manifests, embedded ID3 metadata, and feed/enclosure parity.
- Reject missing audio or package artifacts, digest and metadata mismatch, local feed paths, guest-acceptance overclaims, unsafe text, and publication overclaims.
- Retain source-SHA-bound platform playback evidence before terminal WP-24A completion.
- Keep deployment, mailbox verification, branded-host configuration, directory submission, and publication under the separate launch authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC-1: All ten episodes contain every required script, audio, transcript, note, metadata, artwork, enclosure, redaction, QA, and review artifact.
- AC-2: Audio digests, duration, sample rate, channels, loudness, peak, ID3/artwork, listen check, and archive records are internally consistent.
- AC-3: Feed/enclosure records match episode specs and reject local paths, drafts, unstable GUIDs, missing bytes, and MIME/duration mismatches.
- AC-4: Guest consent, source rights, credentials, synthetic-voice provenance, and redaction remain truthful and privacy-safe.
- AC-5: Required source-SHA-bound platform playback receipts pass digest-recomputing validation before terminal completion, with no deployment or publication claim.

## Non-Goals

- Deployment or podcast-directory submission
- Mailbox verification
- Branded-host configuration
- Treating historical smoke artifacts as final
- Claiming guest acceptance, live unscripted dialogue, weekly cadence, or a public route without proof
- Article ownership

## Rollback

Restore the previous feed and launch-readiness records, remove only episode packages and playback producers introduced by this issue, and retain rejected audio, redaction, consent, metadata, and playback reports under issue evidence. Rollback must not delete upstream Podcast Studio proof, mutate guest consent records, deploy feed changes, or claim publication.

## Canonical current-repository graph

This issue replaces legacy #5845 and supplies the episode-package prerequisite consumed by #51 and #262. Deployment, directory submission, and public-launch authority remain outside this issue.

## Canonical v0.92 ownership allocation

The archived legacy ownership list above is retained only as migration history and is not current execution authority. Current allocation is exact:

- #342 owns only `demos/podcast/episode-packages/**`, including the explicitly non-production parity artifact `demos/podcast/episode-packages/feed-fragment.xml`.
- #342 consumes #261 canonical show identity, artwork, rights, and mailbox-readiness outputs read-only and must not mutate them.
- #262 solely owns the production `demos/podcast/feed.xml` plus production hosting, enclosure publication, HTTP byte-range, and desktop/mobile playback proof.
- #342 must not mutate production feed, hosting, deployment, directory-submission, or public-launch surfaces.


<!-- csdlc-github-operation:v092-342-exact-podcast-allocation-v1 -->
<!-- csdlc-github-operation:v092-342-exact-podcast-allocation-r2 -->

## Sprint 8 working show-name input

For Sprint 8 episode-package preparation, use `The Cognitive Stack` as the operator-directed working show name. Episode package drafts may reference that name, but #342 must continue to consume the terminal #261 identity/artwork/rights/mailbox packet read-only before claiming final production-ready package truth.

This update does not transfer production RSS, hosting, deployment, directory submission, or public-launch authority from #262/#263/#264.
